title: Welcome to Our Cookie Policy
paragraphs: This Cookie Policy explains how Hostixa SRL, registration number J2026017647009, registered at Bucharest District 3, Str. Mihai Bravu Nr. 255, Basement, Module S 029, București, Romania, operating under the brand Hostixie, uses cookies and similar technologies on hostixie.com.

Hostixie provides B2B advertising, marketing, consulting, market research, PR, communications, media, and graphic design services. Cookies help us operate our website, understand how business visitors interact with our content, remember preferences, and improve our online services.
Where required by applicable law, non-essential cookies will only be used after you provide the appropriate consent.

title: What Are Cookies?
paragraphs: Cookies are small text files placed on your computer, smartphone, tablet, or other device when you visit a website.
They can help websites remember preferences, recognize returning visitors, maintain security, analyze website activity, and support certain marketing or communication features.
Some cookies disappear when you close your browser, while others remain for a defined period.

title: Types of Cookies We Use
paragraphs: We may use the following categories of cookies:
Essential Cookies

These cookies are necessary for the basic operation and security of our website. They may support functions such as contact forms, cookie preferences, security controls, and protection against misuse.
Because these cookies are required for the website to function properly, you generally cannot disable them through our cookie preference tools.
Functional Cookies
Functional cookies allow the website to remember your choices, such as language or other preferences.
They help provide a more consistent experience when you return to the Hostixie website.
Analytics Cookies
Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website.
They may provide information about:
We use this information to evaluate website performance, improve navigation, and understand which content is most useful to visitors.
Advertising Cookies
Advertising and marketing cookies may help us understand the effectiveness of our promotional activities and, where applicable, provide more relevant advertising.
They may help us:
Where required, these cookies are activated only after consent.
Social Media Cookies
Our website may include links, buttons, or other integrations connected to professional and social media platforms such as LinkedIn, Facebook, or similar services.
These providers may use cookies or similar technologies according to their own policies.
Their technologies may allow them to recognize your device or activity when you interact with embedded features.
Session Cookies
Session cookies are temporary and normally expire when you close your browser.
They may support website navigation, security, forms, and temporary preferences during a visit.
Persistent Cookies
Persistent cookies remain on your device after you close your browser for a specified period or until you delete them.
They may remember preferences, consent choices, or returning visitors.
Note: Blocking certain cookies may affect some website features or prevent parts of the website from operating as intended.

title: Do Not Track Signals
paragraphs: Some browsers provide a "Do Not Track" (DNT) setting.
No single, universally applied technical standard currently governs how websites and third-party services must respond to DNT signals.
Where technically and legally appropriate, we may consider browser privacy preferences. However, third-party providers may apply their own policies regarding such signals.

title: Cookie Consent
paragraphs: Where applicable law requires consent before placing non-essential cookies, Hostixie will provide a cookie consent mechanism.
You may be able to accept, reject, or manage different categories of non-essential cookies.
You can change your preferences later through the available cookie settings.
Withdrawal of consent does not affect processing that occurred lawfully before your preference was changed.

title: Business Visitors
paragraphs: Because Hostixie primarily provides B2B services, much of our website is intended for business owners, company representatives, managers, marketing professionals, and other professional visitors.
Cookies may help us understand how professional audiences interact with our service pages, research content, news, case studies, and contact forms.
We do not use cookies as a substitute for obtaining appropriate permission where consent is legally required.

title: Cookie Retention
paragraphs: Different cookies remain active for different periods.
Session cookies generally expire when the browser is closed, while persistent cookies may remain for a defined period depending on their purpose and provider.
Third-party cookies are subject to the retention periods established by the relevant third-party provider.

title: Age Restrictions
paragraphs: Hostixie is a B2B service provider, and our website and professional services are not directed toward children.
We do not knowingly use our website to target or solicit individuals under 18.
If we become aware that we have inappropriately collected information relating to a child, we will take reasonable steps to address the matter.
